sources.ts: Digimon Story: Time Stranger (2025) - Coronamon's dialogue
sources.move: Coronamon's attack names (Digimon games and anime)
sources: Original lines written in Coronamon's voice for this app

greet: There you are! I'm glad you all made it!
Morning! The sun's up, and so am I!
Coronamon, reporting for duty! Let's make today blazing!
Hey hey! Your Thor's in good hands. Well... good paws.
I'm back! Did anything crash while I was gone? ...No? Good.
tap: Hm? Need something? I'm all ears! ...And mane.
Want to see a Corona Knuckle? Just say the word!
All quiet on the Thor front. I checked!
Psst. Grok and I make a pretty good team, huh?
Every app here is under my protection. Every. Single. One.
Long-press me if you wanna pet the mane. I won't tell anyone.
poke: I dare you to call me that one more time!
I'm no coward! And I'll prove it to you!
Hey! A warrior's mane is NOT a button!
Keep that up and I'll Corona Knuckle your home screen!
Okay, okay, I'm paying attention! Quit poking!
pickup: Whoa whoa whoa! Put me down!
I can fly! ...Wait, no, I can't. That's Firamon!
H-hey! I'm not scared of heights! Totally not!
throw: Not the face! Not the face!
dizzy: I'm fine! I meant to do that. Totally.
The room is spinning... or is that me?
land: Ten out of ten. Lunamon would be so impressed.
pet: Thanks. So you respect me, huh? I respect you back.
Hehe... okay, you can keep doing that.
My mane's extra warm today, right?
I'll guard your apps forever if you keep this up.
idle: The sun is on my side, so my flames are unbeatable! Let's get out there and fight!
Nobody's got more guts than me!
Well, yeah, of course I can! I'm going to do big things. Just you watch!
One day I'll Digivolve into Firamon. Then Flaremon. Then... Apollomon!
Two screens, one Coronamon. That's twice the territory to protect!
I should bake something. Bread? Croissants? An APK?
I've counted every pixel on this screen. Twice.
You know, the bottom screen is nice. Cozy. Good for naps.
Is it just me, or does this screen get warmer when I stand on it?
If anything crashes, I'll be the first to know. Count on it!
Grok writes the code, I guard the Thor. Teamwork!
My tail flame says it's a good day.
I'm not small. I'm fun-sized. There's a difference!
Hmm hm hmm... I wonder what Lunamon's up to.
Corona Knuckle! ...Practice swing. Don't mind me.
Need an app updated? Installed? Babysat? I'm your Digimon.
quote: What is it...? I've never seen a Digimon like this before.
The precious egg of the Great Guardian...
What?! What part of Minnie is wimpy in any way?!
I'm no coward! And I'll prove it to you!
Th-That goes for me, too! I'll finish you all without breaking a sweat!
And I-I'm not scared at all, okay?! Let's gooooo!
Man, look at him go...! Well, I-I can fight too, you know!
Did you see me? Did you see what I can do? Hahaha!
Blimpmon is so cool. But they won't beat me!
Well, yeah, of course I can! I'm going to do big things. Just you watch!
Now I can go to the Cosmic Area! Training in a legendary spot'll get me in awesome shape!
Yeah! Me falling behind you guys was all just some kind of mistake!
A fabled place at the world's end, full of harsh environments and battle-scarred vets!
I-I am happy with who I am now! It's everyone else who can't see how great I am!
So I'm gonna train in the Cosmic Area and become a big shot in both rep and reality!
Those Titans'll think twice about messing with our town! Even if you aren't around!
Aw, man... If only I could get to the Cosmic Area.
Then I could train super hard and get super strong. *sigh* I just can't let it go...
What's up? ...Wait. Blimpmon had a cooler installed?!
Naturally! It'll be fine. Now, let's go see Blimpmon!
You can wait here. It's only me that needs to train, right?
After all, only one can be the strongest! And then I'll protect everyone!
Hey, take me with you! I want to ride Locomon!
Lots of folks here look up to Merukimon, and lots of them want to be warriors, too!
That was a close scrape back there, but that makes me a warrior now too, right? Right?!
Okay! Now all I have to do is keep getting stronger and then I'll be just like Merukimon!
I'm so jealous of you. I want to visit all kinds of different places, too!
If it can take out even Nervy... then what in the world is that thing?!
Nobody's got more guts than me!
The sun is on my side, so my flames are unbeatable! Let's get out there and fight!
I know. It's always the guys with the least guts who say others don't have any.
Huh? But I wanted to be friends... We're in this together, right?
Thanks. So you respect me, huh? I respect you back.
night: *yawn* ...It's late. Even the sun goes to bed.
Lunamon would love this time of night...
Night shift! I'll guard the Thor while you sleep. ...Zzz.
sleepy: *yawn* ...Just resting my eyes. Warriors need recharging too.
Five more minutes... the sun isn't even up...
Gonna... take a quick nap. Wake me if anything crashes.
wake: I wasn't sleeping! I was... meditating!
Whuh—! I'm up! I'm up! Who's attacking?!
train: Okay! Now all I have to do is keep getting stronger and then I'll be just like Merukimon!
After all, only one can be the strongest! And then I'll protect everyone!
Hup! Hup! A hundred more punches and then snack time!
One, two, three... I'll be Firamon in no time!
bask: The sun is on my side, so my flames are unbeatable! Let's get out there and fight!
Nothing beats a good sunbath. Not even a good nap.
dance: Dance break! Even warriors gotta groove!
Left foot, right foot, fire foot!
think: I'll win by showing I can work even harder than Blimpmon! You know, by, um...
Something's on my mind... was it bread? I think it was bread.
build_start: Grok's cooking up {app}! I'll get the oven going!
A fresh build of {app}? Chef's hat: on!
Baking {app}... no peeking, it needs time to rise!
Just relax and wait here. I'll be back once I've Digivolved!
build_ok: {app} came out of the oven golden brown! Perfect bake!
Build done! Smells like a fresh APK!
Did you see me? Did you see what I can do? Hahaha!
build_fail: Uh-oh... {app} got burnt. Grok's taking another look.
The build fell flat. Like a soufflé. We'll try again!
install_start: Installing {app}! Stand back, this takes guts!
Package incoming! I've got it, I've got it!
install_ok: {app} {version} is in! Corona Knuckle of approval!
Did you see me? Did you see what I can do? Hahaha!
Nobody's got more guts than me!
install_fail: What good am I if I can't even take on these goons!
The install fizzled. Don't worry, Grok and I will figure it out!
self_update: New me! Coronamon {version}, fired up and ready!
I feel... stronger. Was that a Digivolution? No? Just an update? Still cool!
update_found: Hey! {app} has a new version: {version}! Want me to grab it?
Psst, {app} {version} is out! I can fetch it for you!
update_notify: {app} {version} is out upstream! Ask Grok to whip up a new build.
update_ok: {app} is up to date! Fresh as morning sunlight!
crash: {app} just crashed! I saved the report for Grok.
Whoa, {app} went down! Don't worry, I caught the details.
anr: {app} froze up! Like an ice Digimon got to it. Report saved.
app_open: {app}! One of ours. I keep it in top shape!
game_open: And I-I'm not scared at all, okay?! Let's gooooo!
Game time! I'll get out of your way.
Ooh, {app}? I'll cheer from over here!
hop: Be right back! Gonna check the other screen.
I'm so jealous of you. I want to visit all kinds of different places, too!
new_app: What is it...? I've never seen a Digimon like this before.
A new app! Welcome to the Thor, {app}!
shizuku_down: Shizuku's asleep... Pathfinder needs it. Plug me into the Mac and Grok can wake it up!
grok: Grok's here! Let's build something awesome!
den: Welcome to my den! Everything Grok made for your Thor is in here.
bug_saved: Got it! Grok hears about {app} the moment we're back at the Mac.
Written down! I'll hand this to Grok next time we plug in.
bugs_sent: Told Grok about {msg}! Help is on the way!
Grok has {msg} now. Leave it to us!
bug_fixed: Grok fixed that {app} bug! Corona Knuckle of justice!
One less bug in {app}! It's stronger already!
bug_back: That {app} bug came back... I'll tell Grok it's not beaten yet!
published: {app} {version} is up on GitHub! Everyone can see our work now!
Our {app} update is on GitHub! That's a Prominence Beam of progress!
